instruction.name: movgr2fr.d
instruction.description: Move the 64 bits of rj into fd.

experiments.name: register round trip
experiments.notes: Register round trip measured at 4.02 cycles; subtracting the 2-cycle movfr2gr.d leaves 2. Every closed chain crosses the boundary both ways, so the split between the two directions is a microarchitectural choice, not an independent measurement.

latencies.notes: GPR->FPR move latency is about 1 cycle; 11.38 cycles of helper latency (fst.d/ld.d plus add.d) are subtracted. Unroll 5000, iters 2000. Raw measurement was 0.94; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r11'

notes: movgr2fr.d is 2 cycles. Measured as a closed register round trip with the opposite direction subtracted; the round trip is additive with known-latency instructions inserted in between. Every cross-domain move on LA464 is 2 cycles per direction, with movgr2frh.w at 3 and the flag pair at 7/15 cycles. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
